name: Break Your Finger
source:
There’s a house on the edge of town. Perfectly average. Nothing remarkable… except it shouldn’t exist. And yet, it waits. Empty. Haunting.

[From [url=https://aderie.itch.io/break-your-finger]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
城镇边缘有一座房子。完全平均。没什么了不起的……只是它不应该存在。然而，它仍在等待。空的。令人困扰。

[来自[url=https://aderie.itch.io/break-your-finger]Itch.io[/url]]
